##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 12 May 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic, and low pressure to the north of Scotland as various troughs affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or northwest 5 to 7, veering northwest tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate and occasionally rough in the east until later.


##Weather##

Frequent showers, heavy in places, becoming occasional later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 5 to 7, veering north or northwest 4 to 6 Thursday morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
